headline: Nigeria Launches Trade Intelligence Tools to Advance $1 Trillion Economy
summary: The Nigerian government introduced new trade intelligence tools aimed at helping domestic companies access export markets, attract productive foreign investment, and support targets for a $1 trillion economy by 2030.
why: Nigeria is actively promoting non-oil exports and trade facilitation to reduce sovereign revenue dependence on volatile crude oil extraction.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Digital export data platforms help non-oil producers identify foreign market opportunities.
